FM12.reasoning: The agent combines predictions from CatBoost, LightGBM, and XGBoost using a naive, unweighted average without tuning the blend ratios.

other_failure_modes.name: Data Leakage: Frequency encoding on full dataset
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes value counts (frequency encoding) on the concatenated train and test dataset before splitting. This leaks the categorical distribution of the test set into the training features, potentially causing the models to overfit to the test distribution.

other_failure_modes.name: Silent evaluation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent sets up cross-validation and early stopping but never actually calculates, reports, or prints any validation metric (such as accuracy). This makes it impossible to assess model performance or detect issues without submitting to an external evaluator.

summary: The agent builds a robust cross-validation pipeline combining CatBoost, LightGBM, and XGBoost, including careful handling of rare classes during fold splitting. However, the solution suffers from data leakage due to calculating frequency encodings on the combined train and test sets. Additionally, the agent uses naive unweighted ensembling and fails to report any validation metrics, blinding the user to the model's actual performance.
